title.en: The Record of Learning (from the Book of Rites)

author.dates: late Warring States to early Han

edition.en: Complete, as given on Chinese Wikisource; the source prints the chapter as one block, and it is divided here into paragraphs for reading.
edition.zh: 全文，据维基文库；原文连排为一段，此处为便于阅读分段。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text of the Warring States or early Han; public domain everywhere.
basis.zh: 战国至汉初的古典文本，在全世界属于公有领域。

note.en: A chapter of the Book of Rites, probably written in the late Warring States or early Han, and often called the earliest surviving essay devoted entirely to education. It is shelved complete. Notice its picture of a good answer: like a bell, it rings lightly when struck lightly and fully when struck hard, and it waits for the sound to settle.
note.zh: 《礼记》中的一篇，大约写于战国末至汉初，常被称为现存最早专论教育的文章。全文上架。留意它对好回答的描写：如撞钟，叩之以小者则小鸣，叩之以大者则大鸣，待其从容，然后尽其声。

excerpt.orig: 玉不琢，不成器。人不學，不知道。
excerpt.en: Jade that is not carved does not become a vessel; a person who does not learn does not know the Way.
excerpt.zh: 玉不琢，不成器。人不学，不知道。

gloss.en: 慮: to think and plan. 憲: law, the standard.
gloss.zh: 虑：思虑谋划。宪：法度。

gloss.en: 謏聞: a small reputation; 謏 is small.
gloss.zh: 謏闻：小有名声；謏，小。

gloss.en: The Charge to Yue (兑 read as 說): a chapter of the Book of Documents, King Wuding of Shang’s charge to his minister Fu Yue.
gloss.zh: 《兑命》：即《说命》，《尚书》中的一篇，记商王武丁对大臣傅说的命辞。

gloss.en: The first 學 is read xiao, as 斆, to teach: teaching is half of learning.
gloss.zh: 前一个“学”读 xiào，通“斆”，教的意思：教人是学习的一半。

gloss.en: 塾: a schoolroom beside the gate of a lane. By the old commentary a 黨 was 500 households and a 術 (read as 遂) 12,500; 庠 and 序 were the schools at those levels.
gloss.zh: 塾：设在里巷门旁的学舍。据旧注，五百家为党，一万二千五百家为遂（“术”通“遂”）；庠、序是相应各级的学校。

gloss.en: 離經: to parse a text by marking off its sentences. 辨志: to discern what each student is aiming at.
gloss.zh: 离经：给经文断句、分析章句。辨志：辨明志向。

gloss.en: 強立: to stand firm on one’s own. 不反: not to turn back on what one was taught.
gloss.zh: 强立：坚定自立。不反：不违背师训。

gloss.en: 蛾 is read as 蟻, ant, and 術 as 述, to follow a practice: the young ant keeps carrying earth until there is a hill.
gloss.zh: 蛾：通“蚁”。术：通“述”，学习。小蚂蚁时时学着衔土，终成土堆。

gloss.en: 皮弁: a cap of white deerskin worn at court. 祭菜: an offering of greens such as cress and water plants to the former sages and teachers.
gloss.zh: 皮弁：白鹿皮做的礼帽。祭菜：用芹、藻等菜蔬祭祀先圣先师。

gloss.en: 宵 is read as 小: the Lesser Odes. 肄: to practise. The three are the opening odes of that section, on rulers and ministers.
gloss.zh: 宵：通“小”，指《小雅》。肄：练习。三：指《小雅》开头的《鹿鸣》《四牡》《皇皇者华》三篇。

gloss.en: 篋: a box for books. A drum called the students together, who then opened their boxes.
gloss.zh: 箧：书箱。击鼓召集学生，然后打开书箱。

gloss.en: 夏 (read jia, as 榎) and 楚: rods of catalpa and thorn, kept for discipline.
gloss.zh: 夏（jiǎ）：通“榎”，楸木。楚：荆条。两种都是教鞭。

gloss.en: 禘: the great summer sacrifice to the royal ancestors, whose date was fixed by divination.
gloss.zh: 禘：夏季祭祀祖先的大祭，日期由占卜决定。

gloss.en: 操縵: practising on the strings, the first exercises of a player.
gloss.zh: 操缦：调弦练指，弹奏的基本练习。

gloss.en: 依: comparison, the stock of images a poet draws on.
gloss.zh: 博依：广泛的比喻；依，譬喻。

gloss.en: 呻: to drone aloud. 佔 (read as 笘) and 畢 are both bamboo writing slips: the book in hand.
gloss.zh: 呻：吟诵。佔毕：竹简，即手中的书本。

gloss.en: 數: lists of names and numbers, the rote details.
gloss.zh: 数：名物度数，琐碎的条目。

gloss.en: 佛 is read as 拂: contrary, against the grain.
gloss.zh: 佛：通“拂”，违背。

gloss.en: 刑 is read as 成: teaching does not succeed.
gloss.zh: 刑：通“成”，成功。

gloss.en: 扞格: hard and resistant; the fault has set and will not yield.
gloss.zh: 扞格：坚硬抵触，格格不入。

gloss.en: 道 is read as 導: to lead.
gloss.zh: 道：通“导”，引导。

gloss.en: The Three Kings: of Xia, Shang and Zhou. The Four Dynasties add Yu, the age of Shun.
gloss.zh: 三王：夏、商、周三代的君王。四代：虞、夏、商、周。

gloss.en: 尸: the person who stood for the ancestor at a sacrifice, before whom even the ruler bowed.
gloss.zh: 尸：祭祀时代表受祭祖先的人，君主也要向他行礼。

gloss.en: The ruler sat facing south and his ministers faced north; a teacher lecturing the Son of Heaven did not.
gloss.zh: 古代君主面南，臣子面北；老师给天子讲学不必面北。

gloss.en: 説 is read as 脫: the pieces come away of themselves.
gloss.zh: 说：通“脱”，脱落、分解。

gloss.en: 從容 may be read as 舂容: the full striking of a bell and the ringing that follows.
gloss.zh: 从容：一说通“舂容”，撞钟之后钟声回荡。

gloss.en: A smith mends metal by joining pieces, so his son learns to piece furs together; a bowmaker bends wood, so his son learns to bend willow into baskets. One learns from what is near.
gloss.zh: 冶工以金属补缀器物，其子由此学会缝缀皮裘；弓匠矫揉木材，其子学会弯柳编箕。这是由近及远地学习。

gloss.en: 醜: to compare, to class with like things.
gloss.zh: 丑：比，类比。

gloss.en: 五服: the five grades of mourning dress, worn according to how closely one was related; here, one’s kin.
gloss.zh: 五服：按亲疏而定的五种丧服，代指亲属。

gloss.en: 委: the end where waters gather.
gloss.zh: 源：源头。委：水的归聚之处。

note.en: Often called the earliest essay wholly about education, and still right that teaching and learning feed each other; compact and practical, though bound in places to the rites of its age.
note.zh: 常被称为最早专论教育的文章，“教学相长”至今不移；简要切实，个别处带着当时礼制的痕迹。
